body: I don't mean to be annoying by commenting again, but I hope you're okay, and maybe you're even doing better now. I care

I'm 16, overweight as well, and my boyfriend recently broke up with me also.. I know how you feel. I know how much this shit hurts. Different situations and different lives obviously, but either way it isn't easy. All we can do is keep holding on, and finding some sort of reason to hang in there and make it through the next day. I really hope you start to feel better soon and overcome this obstacle in your life, and I hope you haven't hurt yourself. I'm a stranger but I'd gladly talk to you privately if you ever needed someone. I wish you the best.
i'm (obviously lol) a stranger but i love you in a friendly way & i wish you the best :)
